scope: Preregistered exploratory factorial diagnosis, not an adoption gate: 24 stress seed blocks and two on-pool control blocks, each with four arms. Arm 0: usual moves, no HP evidence. Arm 1: usual moves, public HP evidence. Arm 2: exact opponent base move identities for all six roster slots, no HP evidence. Arm 3: exact opponent base move identities, public HP evidence. The move oracle observes a research-only clone with base-slot usage flags set; the true battle and search root are unchanged. HP identity is generic; no true HP type, power, stats or item is explicitly supplied. Full moves can indirectly constrain prior genotypes and preserve live PP; this is a loadout-information intervention, not a type-only causal mechanism. All four arms share initial battle/search seeds and fixed exposure prefixes. The opponent always uses usual moves with public HP evidence. 27000 iterations, c=0.4, default search settings. No outcome-dependent stopping or sample selection. Caps remain unknown; do not convert to ties. Compare paired HP effects separately by move-information condition and their difference; retain all cases and failures to expose. Wins against this bot are regression diagnostics, not a game-theoretic ceiling or human calibration. Current corrected engine is shared by all arms. Fresh seeds are distinct from the frozen prior pilot; teams are reused constructed fixtures. Audit 64 independent determinization samples at every evaluated non-forced multi-action decision; assert all oracle model loadouts equal actual canonical move sets, and record public type contradictions. No adoption or superiority claim from this sample alone.
